All 46 families run exhaustively (every released question) by refs/choice_pass_run.py + choice_pass_a.py/choice_pass_b.py. Each judge decides per option whether it is correct from the statement/figure only; the stored letter is used solely for the final comparison. Requirement per question: exactly one correct option and it is the keyed letter; duplicates in option texts are counted (none).
Validation: a mutated copy of the data with every key shifted to the next option was run through the same judges: 46/46 families flagged 100% of questions, so no judge is vacuous.

Real-world estimate families (abunit, abwunit, adrace time-unit items) use a certifier-owned table of typical sizes/weights/durations (choice_pass_a.LEN, WT, adrace D). Best unit = largest unit in which the size is >= 1 (mm<1cm, cm<1m, m<1km; mg<1g, g<1kg; s<1min, min<1h). Estimate options accepted within a factor 2.5: correct options lie within x1.4 of the typical value, the nearest distractor is >= x8 away; 'sensible' weight records are exactly x1 (sensible) or x1000 / x0.001 (too heavy / too light). Borderline-sized items (500 mg tablet, 2-minute tooth brushing) are judged by the same rule and agree with the key, but depend on the real-world size assumption.

Conceptual classification families: akprim (primary = collected first-hand by the investigator, secondary = taken from a published source; 16 scenarios labelled by the certifier from the sentence), avstatq (statistical question = anticipates variability, i.e. asks about a group; question about one named person = not statistical; declarative sentence = statement), atvtype (scalar: distance, speed, mass, time, energy, work done, density, volume, temperature; vector: displacement, velocity, acceleration, force, weight, momentum, electric field strength; zero/unit/neither by exact norm; equal/negative/collinear by exact cross product; co-initial = same initial point), akssl/akmex/asmex/atindt/ansure/akscale/anvalid/anaxiom (Kolmogorov axioms, enumeration of equally likely outcomes), amirr (minimal polynomial degree > 1 over Q, cross-checked with sympy is_irrational), amterm (long division with remainder cycle detection). None had a stem without content, so none stays Unsupported.

aeampm: the clock figure shows the hour hand position (h mod 12), so 12:00 (24-hour) is drawn as h=0; this is consistent, not a defect. avdirv/anstack/avvcmp/abenough/aaspan/adbartf/aaday/aaseason/aaways/avfold figures were cross-checked against the statement (0 contradictions).

Form/notation observations (not errors): anavgav option 'Yes: the average of the two means is always the mean of everyone' and 'Yes, because the two sections have the same number of students' are judged on their stated reasons; the first is never correct, so a section pair with equal sizes always has exactly one correct option. Word presentations were not wording-verified (only typed-answer equality counted).
